messages.text:
It's perfect, thank you!

Please do a thorough review of all section and subsection names, all tool and setting names and labels and consider if anything would benefit from a rename to make anything more clear to the user, more in conformance with other similar tools and common apps or use less text space.

Search the web as needed for inspiration and really think about what everything in the app actually does, not just what it's currently named.

You said ""Texture displacement" changes stripe contours even when no texture is selected." which seems to corroborate my suspicious that the texture displacement system is not actually working based on the active textures. Check on that, please

Let's get a stronger more functional implementation in place, please. As part of the work, make sure our textures are really good and not too repetitive, I don't want obvious tiling or anything that screams procedural generation. The textures should feel real and optimally should look or feel a bit different each time they are used
Once you're confident that all textures are up to snuff, please proceed according to your labelling recommendations from earlier in the conversation
Session stalled, it probably couldn't contain your awesomness! Please carefully recover your work and thinking, then keep on as you think best.
